notes: Article-level editorial summaries, not verbatim law or a full consolidation. Applicability dates were checked against enacted Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, published 2026-07-24 and in force 2026-07-27. Chapter III Sections 1-3, except Article 6(5), apply from 2027-12-02 for Annex III systems and 2028-08-02 for Annex I systems where the provision applies. Article 27(1) has its own Annex III and deployer limits. The general date remains 2026-08-02; specified new Article 5 prohibitions apply from 2026-12-02. Earlier prohibitions and GPAI provisions keep their earlier dates. Scope and transitional provisions require separate review; dates do not filter gap analysis.
